description: This PHP source file defines the LanguageAPI class, a REST API controller for handling language-related requests in the installer part of the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an abstract installer REST controller and provides a method to retrieve language data.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for retrieving available languages during installation.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve language data; returns a JSON array with language information.
